verdicts.explanation: Table I row x = 0.25 (Li6.75La3Zr1.75Bi0.25O12) gives 5.0 x 10-6 S/cm at 27 °C with relative density 0.80, which the record reports as 80 (a percent conversion, not a mismatch). The 900 °C / 10 h sintering, Pechini synthesis and AC impedance method are all stated in the paper.

Table I row x = 0.5 (Li6.5La3Zr1.5Bi0.5O12) gives 7.2 x 10-6 S/cm at 27 °C with relative density 0.81. The row order matches the table, and the Fig. 3 caption confirms the composition. Sintering and synthesis details match the paper.

Table I row x = 0.75 (Li6.25La3Zr1.25Bi0.75O12) gives 2.0 x 10-4 S/cm at 27 °C with relative density 0.83. The text states this composition has the highest ionic conductivity, and the sintering and synthesis details match.

Table I row x = 1.0 (Li6La3ZrBiO12) gives 1.2 x 10-5 S/cm at 27 °C with relative density 0.84. This is the last row, consistent with the record, and the sintering and synthesis details match the paper.
